huntBeats.text: A woman, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Rosa is showing everyone tall stalks with hand-shaped leaves and thick pale roots by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The journal grows — the human way.

Dmitri leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about ducks in a row. Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces."
